sources: North Carolina DOR remote seller guidance

register_sales_tax.title: Register for North Carolina Sales Tax
register_sales_tax.summary: If you have physical nexus (FBA inventory) or economic nexus ($100,000 (includes marketplace sales)) in North Carolina, registration is required.

steps.title: Register with North Carolina DOR
steps.detail: Apply as a remote seller. Threshold: $100,000 (includes marketplace sales). FBA inventory likely creates nexus (majority rule; no specific carve-out found).
steps.verification_check: Receive a North Carolina sales tax permit/license number.

steps.title: Note filing frequency and due dates
steps.detail: Typical: monthly filing. Returns typically due the 20th of the month following the period. Verify assigned frequency after registration.

steps.title: Configure Shopify and update dashboard
steps.detail: Enable NC tax collection in Shopify for direct orders. Amazon handles marketplace orders. Mark NC as registered in the dashboard.

marketplace_facilitator_notes.title: Amazon Marketplace — North Carolina
marketplace_facilitator_notes.summary: Amazon collects and remits NC sales tax on marketplace orders. This does not eliminate registration or filing obligations.

steps.title: Amazon handles sales tax on Amazon orders
steps.detail: You do not owe additional sales tax on Amazon-facilitated orders.

steps.title: Register and file if nexus exists
steps.detail: If you have physical or economic nexus, registration may be required. Returns show Amazon-collected amounts as marketplace deductions.

steps.title: Collect on Shopify/direct
steps.detail: You are responsible for collecting and remitting on direct (Shopify) orders shipped to NC.
